material_restrictions: No qualified calibrated meta-forecast is available.
Reject four symbol-specific macro trend claims that cite QQQ context instead of the relevant symbol price evidence.
Reject four valuation/profile claims whose sole filing citations do not support the separate calculated profile metrics.
Reject MU intraday downside claim because its comparison with the prior close is reversed.
Secondary-news and issuer-announcement claims establish reported facts or attribution only, not return predictiveness.
audit_summary.summary: Most filing, price, macro, holdings, and carefully attributed news claims are factually supported. Nine claims cannot enter scoring because of citation mismatch, non-atomic valuation assertions, or one reversed price comparison. Across all five symbols, opposing technical, macro, fundamental, and event evidence supports qualitative mixed assessments rather than calibrated directional forecasts.
